# Read in data
```{r}
spring <- read.csv("data/traits/springTraitsAndCorr.csv") |> 
  filter(corr !=1)
mbbs <- read.csv("data/traits/mbbsTraitsAndCorr.csv")|> 
  filter(corr !=1)
cbc <- read.csv("data/traits/CBCTraitsAndCorr.csv")|> 
  filter(corr !=1)
resident <- read.csv("data/traits/ResidentTraitsAndCorr.csv")|> 
  filter(corr !=1)

springMatrix <- read.csv("data/corrMatrices/subsets/SpringSubset.csv")
mbbsMatrix <- read.csv("data/corrMatrices/subsets/mBBSSubset.csv")
cbcMatrix <- read.csv("data/corrMatrices/subsets/CBCSubset.csv")

cbcHeat <- read.csv("data/CBCHistoricData/CBCMERGEDDeltaY.csv") |> select(-year)
springHeat <- read.csv("data/Spring/SpringDeltaYWide.csv")|> select(-year)
mbbsHeat <- read.csv("data/mbbs/mbbsDeltaYWide.csv")|> select(-year)

listOfData <- list(spring, mbbs, cbc, resident)
listOfMatrices <- list(springMatrix, mbbsMatrix, cbcMatrix)
listOfHeat <- list(springHeat, mbbsHeat, mbbsHeat)
seasons <- c("Spring", "mBBS", "Christmas Bird Count", "Residents")
```



# Density of correlation values by survey
```{r}
listOfFigures <- list()
for(i in seq_along(listOfData)){
  figure <- ggplot(listOfData[[i]], aes(x=corr)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), colour="black", fill="white",
                 binwidth = .05) +
  labs(x="Correlation Value",
       y = "Density",
       title = seasons[i]) +
  geom_density(alpha=.2, fill="#FF6666") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.1))
  
  listOfFigures[[i]] <- figure
}

combined <- listOfFigures[[1]] + listOfFigures[[2]] + listOfFigures[[3]]+
  listOfFigures[[4]]
histPlot <- combined + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = 'Yearly Abundance Change Correlation Values Distribution by Survey',
    subtitle = '1999 - 2025',
  )

png(filename = paste("figures/genGraphs/densityPlotCorrValues.png", sep = ""), 
    width = 1000, height = 400)
histPlot
dev.off()
```

# Subsets pheatmap
```{r}

intersections <- intersect(names(springHeat), intersect(names(cbcHeat), names(mbbsHeat)))

cbcHeat <- cbcHeat |> select(any_of(intersections))
springheat <- springHeat |> select(any_of(intersections))
mbbsHeat <- mbbsHeat |> select(any_of(intersections))


#COME BACK HERE
#Gets row/col order based on mbbs
cor_matrixMbbs <- cor(mbbs, method = "spearman")
temp1 <- pheatmap(cor_matrixMbbs, color = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"), main = "mBBS",
                  breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.04))
rowOrder <- temp1$tree_row$order
colOrder <- temp1$tree_col$order

createCorrMatrixSubset <- function(survey, heatmapName, sizeWH, title){
  corMatrix <- cor(survey, method = "spearman")
  #Creates visual of heatmap
  png(filename = paste("figures/heatmap/subsets/", heatmapName, ".png", sep = ""), width = sizeWH, height = sizeWH)
  pheatmap(corMatrix[rowOrder, colOrder], cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           color = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"), 
           main = title,
           breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.04))
  dev.off()
  
  sorting_columns <- c("sp1", "sp2")
  
  corMatrix <- as.data.frame(corMatrix)
  readable_corr <- corMatrix |>
    mutate(sp2 = rownames(corMatrix)) |>
    pivot_longer(col = 0:(ncol(corMatrix)),
                 names_to = "sp1", values_to = "corr") |>
    #remove duplicates
    filter(!(sp1 == sp2))
  
  readable_corr <- readable_corr[!duplicated(apply(readable_corr[,1:2], 1, function(row) paste(sort(row), collapse=""))),]
  
  write.csv(readable_corr, file = paste("data/corrMatrices/subsets/", heatmapName, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = TRUE)
  #return(c(as.matrix(corMatrix), readable_corr))
  return(readable_corr)
}

cbcMatrix <- createCorrMatrixSubset(cbc, "CBCSubset", 600, "CBC - Subset Yearly Abundance Change Matrix")
mbbsMatrix <- createCorrMatrixSubset(mbbs, "mBBSSubset", 600, "mBBS - Subset Yearly Abundance Change Matrix")
springMatrix <- createCorrMatrixSubset(spring, "SpringSubset", 600, "Spring - Subset to mBBS Yearly Abundance Change Matrix")


```
